home.heroText: 33 perfume houses, 590 fragrances. Byredo, Xerjoff, Roja Parfums, Tom Ford and Clive Christian — in one boutique on Nizami street.
home.editorialTitle: A place to choose a scent
home.editorialText1: Parfum City has been open since 2023 in the centre of Baku, on Nizami street. The collection holds 590 fragrances from 33 brands: from classic houses such as Guerlain and Hermès to niche names like Xerjoff, Byredo and Roja Parfums.
home.editorialText2: Prices range from 49 to 2448 manats. You can try a fragrance in the boutique, ask by phone or order to your door via Wolt.
home.service1Text: Free. Daily from 10:30 to 20:30, Nizami street 111.
home.service2Text: Within Baku for 0.49 ₼, about 40 minutes. Minimum order 6 ₼.
home.service3Text: +994 50 995 27 27 — ask about a scent, a volume or availability.
